how: B1952 (main's own recomputation of this note, verification/wa2_on_main.py), part B, and checks/web_review.py R2: the 25 operators X^a Z^b are orthogonal with XZ = zeta^-1 ZX; conjugation by the Weil representation moves them by a linear map of F_5^2, T to (a, b - a) and S to (-b, a), the record's transport; for every Weil class there is exactly one identification of the labels up to a scalar, and its determinant's square class names the class (web-rv-02; the seat's diag(1, 2) and main's diag(1, 3) are inverse, web-st5-02).
